name: bundled-cli-serializes-single-env-var-for-upload
note: A bundled CLI (wrangler shape) that serializes ONE named env var for upload — `JSON.stringify(process.env[name])` — not the whole environment. The bulk-env regex matched `process.env` before the `[key]` index and wrongly read this single-var access as a whole-env harvest, so in the same bundled file as Cloudflare-API network calls it false-BLOCKed the official wrangler CLI on the env+network token-exfil shape. A single-variable serialize is not a bulk harvest; `JSON.stringify(process.env)` (whole env) still is. Regression guard for the top-1000-B false-block fix.
